question: A solid iron sphere of radius 21 cm is melted down into a cone of height 84 cm. What will be the radius of the cone ?
solution:
Given:

A solid iron sphere of radius 21 cm is melted and recast into a cone of height 84 cm.

Formula used:

The volume of a sphere = (4/3)πR³

The volume of a cone = (1/3)πr²h

Where R → The radius of the sphere

r → The radius of the cone

h → The height of the cone

Calculations:

The radius of the sphere (R) = 21 cm

The height of the cone (h) = 84 cm

According to the question,

(4/3)πR³ = (1/3)πr2h

⇒ 4 × 21 × 21 × 21 = r² × 84

⇒ r² = 21 × 21 cm

⇒ r = 21

∴ The radius of the cone is 21 cm.
